Title: GWENT Card Editor
Meaning.Action: Selected cards are then used for:
AbilityHelp.TemplateCopies: New instances of the card named below per execution of this step.
AbilityHelp.BaseCopies: Creates new cards from the source template. This step does not transfer accumulated boosts, armor changes or statuses. Later steps may modify the new cards separately.
Meaning.CopySource.ChosenTarget: Template source: a target selected by the player.
Meaning.CopySource.ChosenCard: Template source: a card from the choice window.
Meaning.CopySource.ChosenOption: Template source: the selected option from the offered cards.
Meaning.CopySource.RandomCard: Template source: a randomly selected card.
Meaning.CopyPlayer.Owner: New cards are created for the ability owner.
Meaning.CopyPlayer.Opponent: New cards are created for the ability owner's opponent.
Meaning.CopyPlace.PlayStack: Spawn zone: the play stack, not the hand or a board row.
Meaning.CopyPlace.SelfZone: Same zone type as this card; for a row, the same row type (melee or ranged). The player side is shown separately.
Meaning.CopyPlace.ChosenCardZone: Same zone type as the selected card. The player side is shown separately.
Meaning.CopyPlace.ChosenRow: Row type is determined by the row selection. The player side is shown separately.
Meaning.CopyPlace.RandomAvailableRow: Spawn position: the end of a random row with available space.
Meaning.CopyRelativePlace.RightOfSelf: Spawn position: to the right of this card.
Meaning.CopyRelativePlace.LeftOfSelf: Spawn position: to the left of this card.
Meaning.CopyRelativePlace.RightOfChosenT: Spawn position: to the right of the selected target.
Meaning.CopyRelativePlace.LeftOfChosenTa: Spawn position: to the left of the selected target.
Meaning.CopyRelativePlace.RightOfChosenC: Spawn position: to the right of the selected card.
Meaning.CopyRelativePlace.LeftOfChosenCa: Spawn position: to the left of the selected card.
Meaning.CopyScope.MultipleSteps: This value is shared by several creation steps and changes all of them whenever they execute.
Meaning.Base: Starting part of the calculation; other additions and multipliers remain.
Meaning.Alternative: Value of a separate alternative branch, not an addition to the normal value.
Meaning.Operation.Set: Operation: set to the specified amount, not add.
Meaning.Target.ChosenTarget: Effect recipient: the player's selected target or selection-shape targets.
Meaning.Target.ChosenCard: Effect recipient: a card from the choice window.
Meaning.Target.Random: The effect recipient is selected randomly.
Meaning.Target.Spawned: The effect applies to cards spawned by this step.
Meaning.Selection.Random: Cards for this step are selected randomly.
Meaning.Selection.Ordered: Random card selection is disabled for this step.
Meaning.Player.Owner: Player for this step: the ability owner.
Meaning.Player.Opponent: Player for this step: the ability owner's opponent.
MeaningHelp.Damage: Damage per execution of this effect. Target and repeat counts are separate.
MeaningHelp.Boost: Boost per execution of this effect. Does not change base power.
MeaningHelp.Heal: Healing limit per execution. Large original values may implement full healing.
MeaningHelp.Strengthen: How much base power to add per execution.
MeaningHelp.BaseLoss: How much base power to remove per execution.
MeaningHelp.SetPower: Set current power to this value, rather than boost by it.
MeaningHelp.SetBasePower: Set base power to this value.
MeaningHelp.SetArmor: Set armor to this value, rather than add armor.
MeaningHelp.ArmorChange: Armor amount for the operation shown below.
MeaningHelp.SelectionMin: Minimum cards to select in this request. Not the number of offered choices or effect repetitions.
MeaningHelp.SelectionMax: Maximum cards selectable in this request. Not the number of offered choices or effect repetitions.
MeaningHelp.SelectionCount: Cards selected in this step. The ability determines the subsequent action and effect area.
MeaningHelp.Spawn: Cards spawned per execution of this specific step.
MeaningHelp.Copy: Copies created per execution of this step. Not the number of existing cards summoned from the deck.
MeaningHelp.Draw: Cards to draw per execution of this step.
MeaningHelp.Reveal: Cards to reveal per execution of this step. Not reveal duration.
MeaningHelp.Profit: Coins from Profit; other coin gains on this card are configured separately.
MeaningHelp.Coins: Coins from this specific effect, not necessarily Profit.
MeaningHelp.Fee: Cost of one Fee activation. Not the effect's amount.
MeaningHelp.Tribute: Tribute cost. Not the amount of the resulting effect.
MeaningHelp.Bleeding: Duration of applied Bleeding in turns, not damage per turn.
MeaningHelp.Vitality: Duration of applied Vitality in turns, not boost per turn.
MeaningHelp.InitialCharges: Initial uses of the existing Order. Charge replenishment is separate.
MeaningHelp.ChargeRefill: Charges added by one activation of the refill condition.
MeaningHelp.ChargeChange: Charges for the operation shown below. Not the card's initial charges.
MeaningHelp.InitialTimer: Initial countdown until the ability triggers. Not an Order cooldown.
MeaningHelp.Cooldown: Turns until the existing Order becomes ready again.
MeaningHelp.CooldownReduction: How much to reduce the target's remaining cooldown.
MeaningHelp.Adrenaline: Adrenaline is active with this many cards in hand or fewer. Shows the in-game value without the internal offset.
MeaningHelp.Berserk: Current-power threshold for Berserk: this value or less.
MeaningHelp.Bloodthirst: Enemy units that must be damaged to satisfy Bloodthirst.
MeaningHelp.PowerFilter: Power boundary when testing or filtering cards. The ability determines subsequent handling. Not damage or boost.
MeaningHelp.ProvisionFilter: Provision boundary when testing a card list. Does not change the cards' provision costs.
MeaningHelp.ChargesFilter: Charge count used to test a condition on a card. Does not add charges.
MeaningHelp.PowerRanking: Selection by power ranking, not comparison against a numeric power threshold.
MeaningHelp.Rows: Rows the player selects, not units on a row.
BackupLocationError: Cannot create the backup folder beside the editor. Choose a writable folder.
BackupPathLong: The path is too long. Choose a folder closer to the drive root.
BackupRestoreHint: Keep this package: it contains rollback files. Restore packages in reverse installation order.
TranslationPreview: Partial interface translation: some text is in English
AudioScope: Reuse another card's native audio without BepInEx. A custom WAV or MP3 can replace premium-preview audio through a separate BepInEx plugin. Both features are experimental.
AudioNativeScope: Reuse another card's complete native audio set: voices, effects and premium audio. Same client only, no BepInEx required. Experimental.
CustomAudioScope: Selected card's premium-preview audio only. Requires an existing BepInEx IL2CPP installation; the loader is not installed automatically. Experimental: in-game playback is not verified yet.
CustomAudioRangeLimit: Select a clip of up to 120 seconds. The source recording stays unchanged.
CustomAudioRange: Choose a non-empty range. Total fade duration must not exceed the selected clip duration.
CustomAudioGainHint: Scales GWENT's effect volume. File preview uses Windows volume without this multiplier.
CustomAudioFormat: WAV requires 16-bit PCM: mono or stereo, 44.1 or 48 kHz, up to 50 MB. Prepared clips must not exceed 120 seconds. MP3 uses a separate decoder.
CustomAudioClient: Open a complete GWENT client folder for custom audio packages.
CustomAudioLoader: Installation requires an existing BepInEx IL2CPP setup. You can save a package, but installation into this client is disabled.
CustomAudioConflict: Package, configuration or plugin files have changed. Overwrite cancelled. Restore later packages in reverse order.
CustomAudioInstallConfirm: Close GWENT. Install the separate experimental plugin and this card's WAV? Disable other audio overrides for this card manually. Native game files stay unchanged.
CustomAudioInstalled: Plugin and WAV installed. Settings load on the next GWENT launch.
CustomAudioRestoreConfirm: Close GWENT. Restore the previous plugin settings and files from this package? Foreign edits will not be overwritten.
CustomAudioRestored: Previous custom-audio files and settings restored.
CustomMp3Missing: The MP3 import component is missing. Use the complete editor with its AudioDecode folder.
CustomMp3Codec: Windows could not open its MP3 codec. Use WAV or check that Windows media components are installed.
CustomMp3Limit: MP3 limit: 50 MB and 30 minutes. The prepared clip must not exceed 120 seconds.
CustomMp3Output: The output exists or matches the input. Overwrite cancelled.
CustomMp3Failed: Could not prepare the MP3. The source is unchanged. See art-worker.log in the editor settings folder.
AudioInstallConfirm: Close GWENT. Replace the selected card's audio set? This changes data_definitions; the package contains a complete archive backup. Appearance and abilities stay unchanged.
AudioInstalled: Audio reassigned. Check the card in game. Client data will reload when this window closes.
AudioRestoreConfirm: Close GWENT. Restore the archive from the audio package? Later changes will not be overwritten: restore other packages in reverse order.
AudioUnsupported: Audio reassignment is not verified for this card or client structure. Changes are blocked.
AudioSameSource: These cards already share one audio set. Choose another card.
AudioWrongPackage: Choose an audio-reassignment package. Restore art and global appearance from their own tabs.
VisualScope: Global settings for gold and bronze cards. Experimental: verify in game. Stats, numbers and statuses stay unchanged.
MediaCheckScope: Check art, frames, audio and rollback on a temporary resource copy. The selected client stays unchanged. Does not replace in-game testing.
MediaCheckConfirm: Run the check on a temporary copy? Requires at least 512 MB of free space and may take a few minutes. No audio playback or game installation.
MediaCheckPassed: Media package check passed. Installation and full rollback verified on a temporary copy. Report:
MediaCheckFailed: The check did not complete successfully. Compatibility with the selected client is not confirmed. See the report:
MediaTestReport: The report must be a new file outside the selected client folder.
FieryInstallConfirm: Close GWENT. Install the appearance and a separate BepInEx animation plugin for all gold cards, excluding leaders? Previous plugin files and settings will be backed up in the package.
FieryScope: Animation for all gold cards, excluding leaders. Requires BepInEx IL2CPP. This preview is static. Multi-card rendering still needs in-game testing.
FieryLoader: Animation requires an existing BepInEx IL2CPP installation. You can export the package, but cannot install it in this client. The static version needs no loader.
FieryConflict: Plugin or appearance files differ from the expected state. Foreign changes were not overwritten. Check package restore order first.
FieryRuntime: Animated-frame runtime is missing or damaged. Restore the complete OptionalPlugins/FieryFiend editor folder.
FieryOutput: Choose a new package folder outside the selected client.
FieryActive: An animated-frame plugin is present. Remove animation before switching to static appearance.
FieryRemoveConfirm: Close GWENT. Remove the animation plugin? Current static appearance remains. A separate backup package will be created for the plugin files.
FieryRemoved: Animation plugin removed. Restart the game. Backup package:
FieryAlreadyRemoved: Animation plugin already removed. No files were changed.
VisualFrameAssets: Built-in frames are missing or damaged. Restore the editor's complete Assets/RogueFrames folder.
VisualInstallConfirm: Close GWENT. Apply appearance to all gold and bronze cards in this client? The package contains a backup.
VisualRestoreConfirm: Close GWENT. Restore the state from before this package was created? If it includes animation, previous plugin files and settings will also be restored. Restore later packages in reverse order first.
VisualInstalled: Appearance installed. Check cards in game.
VisualAlreadyRestored: This package is already restored: files match its backup. Use an earlier package to restore an earlier appearance.
ArtFileConflict: Resource files do not match the state expected by this package. Check the client and package restore order. Nothing was overwritten.
ArtDataConflict: Card data differs from the state used to build this package. Restore later data changes first or select the matching package. Nothing was overwritten.
VisualStarterScope: Starter decks: experimental filter for the deck builder and deck selector. Requires an existing BepInEx IL2CPP installation. No cards or saved decks are deleted.
VisualStarterConfirm: Close GWENT. Install the experimental starter-deck filter into this client? Disable any other deck-hiding mods manually.
VisualStarterRestoreConfirm: Close GWENT. Remove only this editor's starter-deck filter plugin?
VisualStarterDone: Setting saved. Check deck lists after the next game launch.
VisualPluginUnsupported: Requires a client with BepInEx IL2CPP and the complete editor package. The mod loader is not installed automatically.
VisualWrongPackage: Wrong package type. Restore card art from the Art tab and global appearance from the Appearance tab.
ArtScope: Standard illustration only. Stats, text, audio and premium assets stay unchanged.
ArtInstalled: Art installed. The standard card is ready for an in-game check.
ArtInstallConfirm: Close GWENT. Install standard art into this client? The saved package contains the backup.
ArtRestoreConfirm: Close GWENT. Restore art files from the selected package? Files modified after installation will not be overwritten.
ArtNewFolder: Choose a new package folder name that does not exist yet.
ArtNeedsClient: Open a GWENT client folder to edit card art.
ArtCleanSource: First export or undo stat edits and reopen the desired client. Media uses a separate package built from files on disk.
ArtSeparatePackage: The art package is separate from stat exports and contains a backup.
ArtRuntimeMissing: The art-processing component is missing. Use the complete editor build with ArtRuntime.
ArtOperationFailed: Art operation failed. Check file access and art-worker.log in the editor settings folder.
ArtImageTooLarge: Image limit: 25 megapixels and 50 MB; at least 16 pixels per side.
ArtImageUnsupported: Use a still PNG, JPEG or WebP. The file is damaged or unsupported.
SharedBoostDescriptionConflict: Both Deploy descriptions use the same number. Set the same boost for both abilities.
TargetCountTextConflict: The description could not be updated for this target count. Preserve the existing target wording or undo the manual text edit.
CardbackScope: Replace images of seven supported standard card backs. Animations and other card backs remain unchanged.
CardbackUnsupported: This card back or its asset structure is unsupported. Changes are blocked.
CardbackGeometry: Card back layout differs from the verified version. Changes are blocked.
CardbackCatalogMismatch: Card back files do not match the client asset catalog. Changes are blocked.
CardbackCropRatio: The prepared card back image must have a 2:3 aspect ratio.
ArtTextureLayout: This client's texture layout is not supported yet.
ArtShared: Several cards share this art. Isolated replacement is not supported yet.
ArtGameRunning: Close GWENT before installing or restoring art.
ArtConflict: Client files or card data have changed. Overwrite was cancelled to preserve later edits. Keep the original package.
InitialStatusDescription: Selected status names are added to the card description
AdditionalAbilityUnsupported: This ability cannot be added to the selected card.
InitialStatusesUnsupported: Initial statuses are not verified as independent of the graph
StatusNeedsUnit: Regular units only; leaders and tokens need separate verification
StatusNeedsUnitOrArtifact: Regular units and artifacts only; leaders and tokens need separate verification
InitialChargesUnsupported: A simple Order with fixed initial charges is not verified
ChargeTextMismatch: Template charges and the description variable are not synchronized
LocalBalanceNote: Power and provisions come from local files. Balance Council adjustments are not applied.
BalanceSnapshotMissing: No snapshot: power and provisions are locked
BalanceReferenceMismatch: A verified original client base is required
BalanceCoverageMismatch: The snapshot is incompatible with the original base
InvalidBalanceSnapshot: The snapshot is damaged or has an unsupported format
BalanceDownloadFailed: Balance download failed. Open a saved snapshot or uncheck Balance Council.
BalanceCachedAfterFailure: Update failed; using the saved snapshot
BalanceCardMissing: No verified data for this card: power and provisions are locked
BalanceRange: This final value cannot be represented within the local file's supported range
CouncilExportNote: Values include the accumulated Council adjustment. It is subtracted when writing XML. Uncheck for a client without Council patches.
BalanceSwitchConfirm: Power or provisions have already changed. Stored XML values will be kept, but displayed final values may change. Continue?
ExternalValue: An external ability uses this value
AmbiguousValue: The purpose of this value is not verified
UnusedValue: No use of this value was found
SharedAbility: The ability is shared or linked to another card
GraphHasErrors: The graph contains errors: editing is blocked
AbilityRange: The value is outside the verified range
InvalidTargetLimits: Minimum targets cannot exceed maximum targets
InitialValueLocked: This initial value requires graph synchronization checks
CheckDescription: Check literal numbers in the description after editing
DescriptionBinding.Direct: This language's description uses the variable
DescriptionBinding.Formula: This language's description uses a formula with the variable
DescriptionBinding.Unlinked: Text linkage is unverified; review the description
DescriptionBinding.CaseMismatch: Variable letter case differs in the description; review required
DescriptionBinding.UnknownExpression: Description expression is unrecognized; review required
DescriptionBinding.MissingText: No description is available in the interface language
DescriptionWarning: Review descriptions: linkage of edited numbers to text is unverified. Text is not replaced automatically. Languages:
DescriptionAbsentWarning: The source data has no description for these languages:
Ability.shuffle-into-deck-count: Cards to Shuffle into the Deck
Ability.reveal-owner-count: Cards to Reveal for the Ability Owner
AbilityHelp.AdditionalDestruction: The first unit is selected separately to determine border color. This is the number of additional same-color units to destroy. A value of 1 means 2 units in total.
AbilityHelp.RevealAfterSwap: Changes only how many cards are revealed after the swap. The swap itself moves one top-deck card per player; this does not change how many cards are swapped.
AbilityHelp.RevealByPlayer: Cards revealed for the specified player. Not card draw or a swap.
Meaning.MovePlace.DeckRandom: Selected cards are shuffled into the deck using a random position.
Ability.move-to-deck-bottom-count: Cards to Move to the Deck Bottom
Ability.move-to-deck-top-count: Cards to Move to the Deck Top
AbilityHelp.ArmorCondition: Compares armor, not power. A selection or test condition, not the amount of armor to change. Greater than 0 requires at least 1 armor.
AbilityHelp.BasePowerCondition: Compares base power, not current power. A test condition, not a boost.
AbilityHelp.DrawSelected: Cards to select and draw into hand. Selection and actual draw counts change together so they remain consistent.
AbilityHelp.MoveChosenCards: Selected cards to move into the deck in this step. Not additional card draw.
AbilityHelp.DiscardChosenCards: Cards to select from your hand and discard. Not the number of cards drawn.
Meaning.MovePlace.DeckBottom: Move selected cards to the bottom of the deck.
Meaning.MovePlace.DeckTop: Move selected cards to the top of the deck.
Meaning.MovePlayer.Opponent: Destination deck: the ability owner's opponent's.
SurvivalCheck: This is an internal survival check after damage. Editing is blocked.
PowerExtremumSelection: Internal strongest or weakest card selection. Editing is blocked.
ImplicitPowerCondition: Internal power or armor condition without an explicit numeric threshold in the description. Editing is blocked.
SingleStrengthSource: Only the first banished unit supplies the boost amount. The banish count is fixed.
UnusedOrderCondition: Internal unused-Order condition, not a charge count.
ImplicitChargeCondition: Internal empty-charge check, not the initial charge count.
SelfRevealPresentation: Internal reveal of the card itself. The count is fixed.
ChargeActivationSignal: Zero boost is an internal signal for the charge ability. Editing is blocked.
ArmorConversionReset: Armor is cleared when converted into a boost. Not a separate effect amount.
ComputedEffectUnsupported: The computed effect structure or linked values are not verified. Editing is blocked.
Ability.gord-boost-cap: Boost Limit from Played Special Cards
MeaningHelp.GordBoostCap: Maximum boost Gord gains from special cards played this game. Updates both the actual counter cap and the description; the boost per special card is unchanged.
DestructionPresentation: Zero-damage hit before destroying units. Not a separate ability damage amount.
MeaningHelp.SpringTotalDamage: Total Spring damage is distributed as random 1-point hits. Ambush damage comes from the opponent's played card provision cost and is not changed by this setting.
Ability.barnabas-boost: Boost for the Elf, Dwarf and Dryad
AbilityHelp.BarnabasBoost: The same boost applies to every selected unit. The three selections are not tied to specific categories: choose an Elf, Dwarf and Dryad in any order, one unit of each category.
AbilityHelp.NatureSharedTargets: Shared Shaping Nature setting: changes the target count for Veil, Boost and Vitality together. The boost and status apply to every selected target.
ChoiceEffectOwned: This setting belongs to the corresponding choice card.
RandomDamageQuantum: Technical size of one hit in randomly distributed damage.
MeaningHelp.FirstTargetDamage: Damage of the first hit to the selected target. Subsequent random hits are configured separately.
MeaningHelp.RandomDamageSeries: Starting damage of three random hits, each 1 lower than the previous: 5 means 5, 4, 3. Linked description values update together. The number of hits is unchanged.
MeaningHelp.LinkedElephantBoost: Boost for one adjacent unit. Two adjacent units and Crew use twice this value, e.g. 5 and 10. One setting updates both amounts; Crew's boost cannot be changed independently in this graph.
AbilityHelp.AlternativeStrengthTransfer: One setting for both alternative branches. One unit is banished; each selected allied unit is boosted by its power. The conditional branch expands the eligible border color, not the number of activations.
AbilityHelp.HighestCount: How many units to select, starting with the strongest. Not damage or a power threshold.
AbilityHelp.LowestCount: How many units to select, starting with the weakest. Not damage or a power threshold.
AbilityHelp.HighestLevels: At 1, selects units with the highest power. Sets the number of power levels considered, not damage or the number of units damaged. The ability then chooses its target.
AbilityHelp.LowestLevels: At 1, selects units with the lowest power. Sets the number of power levels considered, not damage or the number of units damaged. The ability then chooses its target.
AbilityHelp.SelectedRows: Number of rows the player selects for the ability. Not the number of units on a row.
Ability.spawn-count-owner: New Cards for the Ability Owner
Ability.spawn-count-owner-melee: New Cards in Your Melee Row
Ability.spawn-count-owner-ranged: New Cards in Your Ranged Row
SelectionColorAnchor: First unit determines the border color
DescriptionNotChanged: The card description is not updated automatically
ZealNeedsOrder: Requires an existing unit Order with initial charges
GraphControlsZeal: The graph controls same-turn Order readiness
UnsupportedZealGraph: This graph is not yet verified for this toggle
MeaningHelp.InitialPatience: The card's initial Patience counter before it grows. It may determine damage, boost, duration, card count, or the provision cost of a created Spell. Does not change Patience growth per turn.
LeaderLocalNote: Leader provisions use local values independently of Balance Council.
LeaderFieldsLocked: Only leader provision bonus, verified numbers and texts can be edited.
LeaderNumberUnsupported: This leader parameter is not supported yet.
TokenLocalNote: Token values come from local files. The creating card may modify them on spawn.
ReferenceNote: Direct card references are shown. They do not always mean spawning; dynamic and nested links may be absent.
ClientNotFound: data_definitions was not found. Choose a GWENT client folder.
Name: Name
name: Name
Discard: There are unsaved changes. Discard them?
SaveDraft: Apply changes to the selected card?
ResetConfirm: Reset all changes? This can be undone.
ExportFolder: Choose a parent folder for a new export
Exported: Export created. The source client is unchanged.
ClientExported: Export created. Install only data_definitions from the top level. The _editor folder contains the backup and report: do not copy it into the game. The source client is unchanged.
MissingLocale: This language file is not present in the client. Text editing is unavailable.
MissingText: This card has no such text entry in the language file.
TextSafety: Formatting tags and variables must be preserved. Line break: \n.
Scope: Basic parameters. Exports never overwrite source files.
HiddenOrGenerated: Hidden service entry: editing is blocked.
UnsupportedType: This card type is not supported by the basic editor.
UnsupportedFields: Unrecognized card structure or values: editing is blocked.
SecondaryFactionInvalid: The primary and secondary factions must be different.
PhysicalLine: Text must occupy one physical line. Use \n instead of Enter.
TextTokens: The basic editor cannot change or remove formatting tags or variables.
NoChanges: There are no changes to export.
ExportExists: The output folder already exists. Choose a new path.
ExportInsideSource: Cannot export inside the client folder.
SourceChanged: Source files changed outside this session. The operation was stopped to protect external changes. Do not close the editor if you have unsaved changes.
FactionNote: Changing the primary or secondary faction does not rewrite ability conditions or targets. The secondary faction is optional and must differ from the primary faction.
UnknownBits: Unrecognized category bits are preserved unchanged.
FirstBanishChoices: First banish from deck: card count
AbilityHelp.GigaCondense: Damage of each of six strikes against the selected unit. Strike count stays at 6; the other choice's random damage is unchanged.
AbilityHelp.GigaSpread: Total damage randomly split across an enemy row in 1-damage hits. Does not change the focused choice's damage or strike count.
AbilityHelp.VeteranStrengthen: Owner's base-power gain when Veteran triggers. Existing trigger conditions are preserved.
AbilityHelp.BranStartVeteran: Base-power gain for Veteran units at game start. Not Bran's own between-round Veteran or his Deploy boost.
AbilityHelp.UnbondedCopies: Copies in the regular Deploy branch, without Bonded. Does not change the Bonded branch's copy count.
AbilityHelp.BondedCopies: Copies when Bonded is active. Does not change the regular branch's copy count.
LeaderEntityReplacement: This recreates the leader entity, not ordinary cards.
LeaderResetSignal: This is a leader-reset signal, not a boost.
